capabilities: display a thumbnail from a configurable property name
hide the metadata container when file properties is active
extras: README is minimal; it lists two features plus install and build instructions, with no screenshots or configuration examples.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances Obsidian's file properties view
problem: Obsidian's properties view only displays raw frontmatter fields, with no visual thumbnail preview and no way to hide the metadata container when it is active.
summary: Properties view enhancement that shows a configurable thumbnail image and can hide the metadata container while the properties view is active.
